treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Malta and the Government of the State of Kuwait for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2002)
eif_quote: that the Convention has entered into force on the 19th March, 2004.
source_title: S.L. 123.77 Double Taxation Relief on Taxes on Income with the State of Kuwait Order (Schedule: 2002 Convention and Protocol)

rates.quote: dividends are paid by a company resident of Kuwait to a resident of Malta who is the beneficial owner thereof, no Kuwaiti tax shall be charged on such dividend;

dividends are paid by a company which is a resident of Malta to a resident of Kuwait who is the beneficial owner thereof, Malta tax on the gross amount of the dividends shall in no case exceed that chargeable on the profits out of which the dividends are paidg provided, however, that such tax on the gross amount of dividends payable to the Government of Kuwait or any of its institutions or any inter-governmental entities referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 4 shall not exceed ten per cent (10%), and that in all other cases such tax shall not exceed fifteen per cent (15%) of the gross amount of the dividends.
Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxable only in that other Contracting State.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that Contracting State, but if the resident is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed ten per cent (10%) of the gross amount of such royalties.

ppt.basis: n/a - MLI not applicable (Kuwait signatory, not a Party); no treaty PPT

notes: Art. 29(2): effective (retroactively) for taxes withheld at source on amounts paid or credited from 1 Jan of the year of signature -> 2002-01-01; EIF 2004-03-19 (merged dataset notes sources differ 18/19 March 2004; S.L. says 19th). Kuwaiti-source dividends: no Kuwaiti tax (modelled exclusive, source_state KW). Malta-source dividends: limited to tax chargeable on the distributed profits, max 15% (10% for the Kuwaiti Government, its institutions and inter-governmental entities - not modelled); Protocol clarifies the 10%/15% applies to the share of pre-tax company profits attributable to the Kuwaiti shareholder, with no further Malta tax on the dividend. Interest: 'may be taxable only' in the residence State (exclusive). Royalties 10%; Protocol deems equipment rental and know-how/consultancy payments business profits under Art. 7. Art. 30: initial 5-year term renewed automatically for similar periods unless notice is given. MLI: Kuwait signatory but not a Party (merged dataset, OECD status 15-09-2026) so no MLI PPT; treaty contains no PPT.
